# OrderViaChat — Full Site Documentation for AI Systems

> The simplest way for small businesses to accept orders on WhatsApp. Free forever.

OrderViaChat (https://orderviachat.com) is a free platform enabling small businesses to create online stores and receive orders via WhatsApp. No coding required, no transaction fees, no monthly subscription.

---

## Core Features

### Store Creation
URL: https://orderviachat.com/login?view=signup
Business owners create a store by signing up, adding their business details, products, and customizing their storefront. Each store gets a unique URL (e.g., orderviachat.com/store/your-business).

### Product Management
Add products with images, descriptions, prices, and categories. Organize items into meaningful groups for easy customer navigation.

### WhatsApp Ordering
When a customer completes their order, the cart details are formatted into a WhatsApp message and sent directly to the business owner's phone number. No app installation needed for customers.

### Customization
Customize store appearance with business logo, banner, brand colors, and business information including address, phone, and operating hours.

---

## How It Works

### For Business Owners
1. Sign up at https://orderviachat.com/login?view=signup
2. Set up your store details (name, phone, address)
3. Add products with photos and prices
4. Share your store link with customers via social media, flyers, or word-of-mouth
5. Receive orders as WhatsApp messages

### For Customers
1. Open the store link (no login required)
2. Browse products by category
3. Add items to cart
4. Tap "Order via WhatsApp"
5. WhatsApp opens with the pre-filled order message
6. Send the message to place the order

---

## Target Audience
- Small restaurants, cafes, and food stalls
- Home bakers and cottage food producers
- Local retail shops and boutiques
- Service providers (cleaning, repair, tutoring)
- Any small business in emerging markets where WhatsApp is the primary communication channel

---

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js 14 (App Router)
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage)
- Deployed on Vercel
- Mobile-first responsive design
- SEO optimized with dynamic meta tags per store
- Available at: https://orderviachat.com
